about.title: About Us
about.description: Loadly is a logistics and freight content platform, publishing practical guides and industry insights for shippers, carriers, and logistics professionals worldwide.
about.fastEasyDesc: Find clear answers on freight costs, routes, and regulations in minutes — no digging through scattered sources.
about.reliableDesc: Every guide follows written editorial rules and automated quality checks before publishing. See our Editorial Policy for details.
about.wideDesc: In-depth logistics coverage spanning Turkey, Europe, the Middle East, and beyond.
about.visionP1: By making reliable, practical logistics knowledge accessible in every major language, we aim to help shippers, carriers, and logistics professionals everywhere make better-informed decisions.
about.visionP2: We continue to expand our library of guides and analysis — covering freight costs, routes, and regulatory changes — so our readers always have access to current, accurate information.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: You can always contact us for your questions, comments, or suggestions. Our team will get back to you as soon as possible.
contact.quickSupportDesc: We recommend using our email channel for your urgent support needs regarding advertising opportunities, collaborations, or account management. We return within 24 hours at the latest.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.description: A detailed, cookie-by-cookie breakdown of what Loadly and its third-party providers store in your browser, and why.
cookiePolicy.introDesc: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They let a site remember your preferences, keep you signed in, and — where you've consented — measure traffic and show relevant ads. This page lists, individually, every category of cookie Loadly and its providers use. For how we handle the personal data cookies may touch, see our Privacy Policy.

rows.name: cookie-consent
rows.purpose: Stores your cookie consent choice (accepted or declined) so we don't ask again on every visit. Stored in local storage, not a traditional cookie.
rows.duration: Persistent, until you clear your browser's site data

rows.name: sb-access-token / sb-refresh-token
rows.purpose: Keeps you signed in to your Loadly account between page loads.
rows.duration: Session, up to 7 days for the refresh token
rows.provider: Supabase, on Loadly's behalf (first-party, strictly necessary)

rows.name: _ga, _gid
rows.purpose: Distinguish and count unique visitors for aggregate traffic analytics. Only set once you accept cookies.

rows.name: IDE, test_cookie, and related advertising cookies
rows.purpose: Used by Google AdSense/DoubleClick to serve ads and measure ad performance based on your visits to this and other sites. Only set once you accept cookies.
rows.duration: Varies by cookie, typically up to 13 months

cookiePolicy.rowsNote: Google controls the exact list and lifetime of its own analytics and advertising cookies, and these can change without notice on our end — see Google's own cookie documentation for the current, authoritative list.
cookiePolicy.manageDesc: You can accept or decline non-essential (analytics/advertising) cookies from the consent banner shown on your first visit, or change your choice at any time by clearing your browser's site data for loadlyapp.com. You can also opt out of personalized advertising directly with Google:
cookiePolicy.browserDesc: Every modern browser lets you block or delete cookies from its settings. Note that blocking strictly-necessary cookies (like the sign-in cookies) may stop parts of Loadly — like staying signed in — from working correctly.
cookiePolicy.contactDesc: If you have questions about this Cookie Policy, contact us at:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Loadly collects, uses and protects personal data on loadlyapp.com and in the Loadly Android app.
privacy.disclaimer: Loadly publishes freight and logistics guides on this website. The Loadly Android app additionally shows freight listings from external sources and lets you contact the listing owner directly. Loadly is not a broker, carrier or freight forwarder and is not a party to any shipping agreement.
privacy.overviewDesc: This policy explains what personal data is processed when you read loadlyapp.com or use the Loadly Android app, why, and what choices you have. Loadly is run by Eren Şimşir as an individual (not a registered company), who is the data controller and can be reached at kvkk@loadlyapp.com. Depending on where you live, we process data on the basis of your consent (analytics and advertising cookies), performance of a contract (account and app features), our legitimate interests (security, preventing fraud and abuse, keeping the service running) and legal obligations.
privacy.dataDesc: Depending on how you use Loadly, we may process the following data:
privacy.dataL1: Website visitors (no account needed): technical data such as IP address, browser type, device information and access times, which our servers receive when a page is requested; and, only if you accept cookies, usage data collected by Google Analytics (pages viewed, approximate location, device and browser).
privacy.dataL2: Account information (only if you register through the website or the app): full name, email address, phone number, company name (optional) and user role (shipper/driver).
privacy.dataL3: Content you provide (only if you use those features): listings you create, route, date and location details, and messages sent through the platform together with their conversation history.
privacy.dataL4: Contact requests: if you email us, we process your email address and the content of your message to reply.
privacy.dataL5: Advertising data: if you accept cookies, Google AdSense (website) and Google AdMob (app) may collect identifiers and browsing or app-usage data to show and measure ads. See section 4.
privacy.dataL6: Android app: if you grant location permission, your device location is used on the device (via Android Geocoder) to determine your country and subscribe you to that country's push-notification topic via Firebase Cloud Messaging; raw coordinates are not sent to or stored on Loadly's own servers. The app also holds a Firebase push-notification registration token (needed to deliver notifications) and, if you accept ads, an advertising identifier used by Google AdMob.
privacy.dataL7: Android app diagnostics: crash reports and device diagnostics (for example device model, Android version and the technical state of the app when it crashed) are sent to Firebase Crashlytics so we can fix bugs.
privacy.dataNote: Loadly does not process payments and does not collect payment card or bank details.
privacy.useDesc: We use the data above only for the following purposes:
privacy.useL1: Providing the website and the app, including account creation and sign-in
privacy.useL2: Showing freight listings and enabling messaging and contact between users of the app
privacy.useL3: Route- and load-type search in the app
privacy.useL4: Keeping the service secure and preventing fraud, abuse and spam
privacy.useL5: Measuring traffic and improving the website and the app (analytics and crash reports)
privacy.useL6: Showing and measuring advertisements, where you have allowed it
privacy.useNote: We do not use your personal data to process payments, and we do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing.
privacy.cookiesDesc: When you first visit the website a banner lets you accept or reject non-essential cookies. Until you accept, analytics and advertising storage stay switched off (Google Consent Mode); if you reject, they stay off. Visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland may also see a consent message from Google, which applies to Google's advertising cookies. Categories we use:
privacy.cookiesL1: Strictly necessary: keeping you signed in and remembering your cookie choice. These do not require consent.
privacy.cookiesL2: Analytics (Google Analytics 4): counts visits and shows which pages are read. Only used after you accept cookies.
privacy.cookiesL3: Advertising (Google AdSense): shows and measures ads. Only used after you accept cookies.
privacy.cookiesNote: When you reject, Google may still receive limited signals that do not use cookies, which is how Consent Mode works. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings; some features, such as staying signed in, may then stop working.
privacy.cookiesAdDesc: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this website and other websites. Google’s use of advertising cookies (including the DoubleClick cookie) enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet. Where required (for example in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland), personalized ads are only shown with your consent.
privacy.cookiesAdNote: You can manage or opt out of personalized advertising at any time using the links below:
privacy.cookiePolicyLinkText: See the full cookie-by-cookie breakdown in our Cookie Policy.
privacy.thirdPartiesDesc: We share personal data only with the following recipients and only as far as needed:
privacy.thirdPartiesL1: Service providers that run the platform on our behalf: Supabase (database and sign-in), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (hosting), and Google (Analytics, AdSense and AdMob advertising, Firebase Cloud Messaging and Crashlytics).
privacy.thirdPartiesL2: Authorized public institutions, where the law or a lawful request requires it.
privacy.thirdPartiesL3: Legal advisors, where needed to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
privacy.thirdPartiesNote: We do not share your personal data with payment providers (Loadly does not process payments) and we do not use it for marketing by third parties.
privacy.transfersDesc: Our providers may process data in the United States and in other countries outside your own. Where the law requires safeguards for such transfers, we rely on the ones our providers offer, such as standard contractual clauses.
privacy.retentionDesc: Account data is kept while your account exists. You can delete your account at any time from the Delete Account page, after which we delete or anonymize your personal data, except for what we must keep to comply with the law or to handle legal claims. Server logs, analytics data and crash reports are kept for as long as the respective provider’s retention settings and our security needs require.
privacy.securityDesc: The website is served over HTTPS. Access to personal data is limited to what is needed to run the service, and we depend on the security measures of our hosting and database providers. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.childrenDesc: Loadly is intended for adults working in freight and logistics and is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.rightsDesc: Under the GDPR, the UK GDPR and Turkey’s KVKK, you have the following rights:
privacy.rightsL1: Access and receive a copy of your personal data
privacy.rightsL2: Have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected
privacy.rightsL4: Object to the processing of your data
privacy.rightsL5: Receive your data in a portable format
privacy.rightsL6: Restrict processing, and withdraw consent at any time (withdrawing does not affect processing carried out before)
privacy.rightsNote: To exercise these rights, email kvkk@loadlyapp.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority (in Turkey, the Personal Data Protection Board; in the EU or UK, your national supervisory authority).
privacy.changesDesc: We may update this policy when the law or our services change. The “Last updated” date at the top shows the current version, and we will publish changes on this page. Please check it from time to time.
privacy.ccpaDesc: If you are a California resident, you have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA):
privacy.ccpaL1: The right to know what personal information we collect and how it is used
privacy.ccpaL2: The right to request deletion of your personal information
privacy.ccpaL3: The right to opt out of the “sale” or “sharing” of your personal information — a term that, under CCPA, can include allowing third-party ad providers like Google AdSense to use identifiers for personalized advertising
privacy.ccpaNote: To exercise any of these rights, email kvkk@loadlyapp.com with the subject "California Privacy Request". You can also opt out of personalized advertising directly via the Google Ads Settings link above. We do not discriminate against you for exercising these rights.
privacy.contactDesc: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, contact the data controller (Eren Şimşir, Loadly) through the following channel:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms that apply when you use loadlyapp.com and the Loadly Android app.
terms.disclaimer: Loadly is an information publisher, not a broker, carrier or freight forwarder. Articles are general information and are not legal, customs, tax or other professional advice. No payments are processed through Loadly.
terms.acceptDesc: By using loadlyapp.com or the Loadly Android app you confirm that you have read and accepted these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use them. Use is also subject to all applicable laws.
terms.serviceDesc: The website publishes free articles and guides about freight and logistics. The Android app additionally shows freight listings collected from external sources and lets you contact the listing owner directly. Loadly is not a party to any agreement between shippers and carriers: it does not arrange transport, mediate contracts, or handle payments. All arrangements are made directly between the parties involved.
terms.accountDesc: Reading the website does not require an account; some features of the app do. If you create an account, you promise that the information you give is accurate and complete, that you will keep your sign-in details to yourself, and that you are responsible for all activity under your account.

terms.rulesL1: Do not engage in any unlawful activity
terms.rulesL2: Respect the rights of other users
terms.rulesL3: Do not provide false or misleading information
terms.rulesL4: Do not harm or overload the technical infrastructure of Loadly
terms.rulesL5: Do not send spam, harassment or unsolicited messages
terms.rulesL6: Do not access other users’ account information without permission
terms.rulesL7: Do not attempt to gain unauthorized access to Loadly’s systems or interfere with their security
terms.liabilityDesc: Loadly is provided “as is” and “as available”. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we accept no liability for indirect or consequential losses, or for the following:
terms.liabilityL1: Informational content: articles are general information based on our research, and we do not guarantee that they are complete, current or suitable for your situation. Check official sources and get professional advice before making legal, customs, tax or business decisions.
terms.liabilityL2: External listings: listings shown in the app come from third-party sources and are not verified by Loadly; the listing owner is responsible for their accuracy (price, weight, load type and so on).
terms.liabilityL3: Contracts between parties: Loadly is not responsible for the content, performance or breach of any agreement between a shipper and a carrier.
terms.liabilityL4: Damage, loss or delay during transport: the parties involved are responsible for it.
terms.liabilityL5: Payments: no payments occur through Loadly, and Loadly is not responsible for payment obligations between parties.
terms.liabilityL6: Identity verification: Loadly does not verify the identity of users or listing owners. Verifying the identity and authorization of the other party is your responsibility.
terms.liabilityL7: Legal compliance: the parties are responsible for carrying out transport in accordance with all legal requirements.
terms.liabilityL8: Service interruptions: Loadly is not responsible for losses caused by the website or app being unavailable for technical reasons.
terms.liabilityL9: Force majeure: Loadly is not responsible for disruptions caused by natural disasters, war, pandemics, technical failures or similar events beyond its control.
terms.adsDesc: The following applies to third-party content and to communication through Loadly:
terms.adsL1: The website links to third-party sites, such as official agencies. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content.
terms.adsL2: The website and app show ads served by Google. We do not endorse advertisers and are not responsible for their products or claims.
terms.adsL3: Listings and messages you create must relate to freight and be accurate and lawful; you are responsible for their content.
terms.adsL4: Misleading, insulting or illegal content may not be published.
terms.adsL6: Loadly is not responsible for communication between listing owners and carriers.
terms.ipDesc: The articles, design, brand and logo of Loadly are protected by intellectual property rights and belong to Loadly. You may share links to our pages and quote short excerpts with clear attribution and a link back; other copying, distribution or commercial use requires permission. Content that users upload remains theirs, and by publishing it on Loadly they grant Loadly the right to display it for the purpose of running the service.
terms.terminationDesc: Loadly may temporarily or permanently suspend accounts that violate these terms and will inform the user. You can delete your own account at any time from the Delete Account page. After deletion, some personal data may still be kept where legal retention obligations require it, as described in the Privacy Policy.
terms.disputeDesc: We will first try to resolve any dispute amicably. If that is not possible, the laws of the Republic of Turkey apply and the Istanbul Courts and Enforcement Offices have jurisdiction, without affecting any mandatory consumer-protection rights you have under the law of the country where you live.
terms.changesDesc: We may update these terms from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top shows the current version. If you keep using Loadly after a change, you accept the updated terms.

accountDeletion.title: Delete Your Account
accountDeletion.description: How to permanently delete your Loadly account and personal data, from the website or the Android app.
accountDeletion.intro: You can permanently delete your Loadly account and its data at any time — the same account works on both the website and the Android app.
accountDeletion.signedInPrompt: Sign in below, then go to Profile → Delete My Account to remove your account instantly.
accountDeletion.notSignedInNote: No longer have access to your account? Email {email} from the address registered on the account and we'll delete it for you within 30 days.
accountDeletion.whatGetsDeletedL1: Your profile: name, email, phone number, company name
accountDeletion.retainedNote: Some data may be retained for a limited period where required by law (e.g. fraud prevention, tax/legal record-keeping) — see our Privacy Policy.
